certifications.proof_quote: We engage with third party auditors to assess our SOC 2 Security compliance. SOC 2 is an internationally recognized standard for managing customer data.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No mention of ISO 27001 found on the Trust Center, Privacy Policy, or GDPR pages.

certifications.name: Penetration testing (CREST-approved testers)
certifications.proof_quote: We regularly use specialist penetration testing companies (CREST approved) to test our whole platform, ensuring we discover and fix any security issues.

certifications.name: GDPR compliance posture
certifications.proof_quote: We comply with all applicable data protection laws, including the GDPR... All third-party providers have been verified as GDPR-compliant (Azure, Stripe, SendGrid, PayPal, Google, HotJar, Oribi, ShareASale, Microsoft Clarity, Iterable).

certifications.name: Bug bounty program (HackerOne / Bugcrowd)
certifications.proof_quote: No managed bug-bounty platform referenced. GDPR page only states: 'Users and security researchers can submit security reports via this link.'

privacy.ai_training_note: ProWritingAid explicitly states it does NOT train its models on customer text. 'When using ProWritingAid, your texts will not be used to improve the quality of our services. We use texts hand corrected by professional copyeditors to train our algorithms.' Grammar-checked text is deleted after processing; only documents a user explicitly saves in the Web Editor are retained (encrypted) in the cloud. Trust Center: 'Our writing suggestions use our unique Natural Language Processing models that never retain your text.'
privacy.data_region: Primary processing in the United Kingdom; data stored on servers in the USA, with service providers also operating in the EEA and US. GDPR page: 'All ProWritingAid data is held on servers hosted outside of the EU in the USA.' Cross-border transfers covered by Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs).

products.data_scope: Adds billing/payment data (handled by Stripe/PayPal) on top of writing data.
products.notes: Monthly, yearly and lifetime license options historically offered.

products.notes: Limited public detail on a distinct enterprise data/compliance scope; warrants direct confirmation for B2B procurement.

flags: SOC 2 language is aspirational/in-progress ('engage with third party auditors to assess our SOC 2 Security compliance') rather than a confirmed report; no report date, scope, or attestation published. Treat as NOT a held certification.

Strong, clear no-training and no-retention stance on customer text is a positive differentiator versus many competitors.
